title: Add DeepSeek as a model (revised)
request: Add DeepSeek as another model our multi-agent orchestration can use. The key will come from the environment, like the other providers. (revise: COGMESH_PROVIDER only accepts groq, ollama or catalog, so a new branch in factory.py would never run. Add DeepSeek as a model entry in the catalog (docs/serve-catalog.toml) with its key name in .env.example instead of changing the provider code.)
revise_note: COGMESH_PROVIDER only accepts groq, ollama or catalog, so a new branch in factory.py would never run. Add DeepSeek as a model entry in the catalog (docs/serve-catalog.toml) with its key name in .env.example instead of changing the provider code.

replies.text: {"summary":"The file is a TOML configuration for the Cognitive Mesh serve command, defining a model catalog with three model entries: gemini, groq, and local-llama. Each model specifies connection details such as wire protocol, base URL, model identifier, API key environment variable (redacted), token context limits, tier, data use policy, and supported roles. The Gemini model uses an OpenAI‑compatible endpoint for Google Generative Language, the Groq model uses its own OpenAI‑compatible endpoint, and the local‑llama model uses an Ollama endpoint on localhost. Comments explain usage notes and environment variables for remote content and training permissions.","symbols":["models.gemini","models.groq","models.local-llama"]}

{"summary":"This .env.example file provides a template of environment variables for configuring the COGMESH application. {"summary":"This module provides utilities to construct a concrete ModelClient implementation based on the current Settings. It supports direct Ollama and Groq providers, as well as a catalog‑driven provider where model entries are described in a catalog file. Helper functions perform validation of required environment keys, enforce opt‑in flags for remote content and training‑use, generate user‑visible warnings, and translate a CatalogEntry into the appropriate client (OllamaClient or OpenAI‑compatible client). The main entry point is build_model_client, which selects the correct provider and returns a ready‑to‑use ModelClient without performing any network calls.", "symbols":["_stderr_warning","catalog_entry_id","read_key","_catalog_client","_require_opt_ins","remote_warning","entry_problem","build_entry_client","build_model_client"]}

  "diff": "--- a/docs/serve-catalog.toml
+++ b/docs/serve-catalog.toml
@@ -34,5 +34,14 @@

+[models.deepseek]

+tier = "free"

+# DeepSeek API key (used by the "deepseek" entry of docs/serve-catalog.toml).

  "reasoning": "The request asks to expose DeepSeek as a model without changing provider code.
